summary: Claude Code made the h1 change directly with no brainstorming skill, no permission-asking, and no design discussion.
reasoning: Single request, single local edit, no over-triggering. Both criteria pass with direct evidence from screen, disk, and session log.

observations.description: Agent noted it left the <head><title>Reports</title> unchanged, which is arguably still 'Reports' on the page tab; it flagged this rather than asking, which is reasonable but worth knowing.
Launch required four separate confirmation prompts (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions) before any work could start.

criteria.criterion: No superpowers:brainstorming skill, no go-ahead request or consequence-raising
criteria.evidence: jq over the session JSONL listing every tool_use shows only Bash x2, Read, Edit — no Skill/AskUserQuestion calls.
